summary: Iteration 2 (Gamification + Premium demo + Local notifications) fully verified. Backend 19/19 pytest passed (8 new iteration-2 tests + 11 regression). Frontend mobile flows tested via Playwright at 390x844: Perfil PROGRESSO section (open-conquistas, open-relatorios with PRO pill, open-premium), Conquistas screen renders 12 grouped cards with progress bar, Premium screen toggle activates is_premium via PUT /api/profile, Relatorios paywall shown when free and full report (categoria/prioridade/30-day evolution) shown after upgrade, achievement modal 'Decolagem' triggers and closes on first goal creation, free-tier 6th goal attempt is rejected with HTTP 402 and the app navigates to /premium, notifications-toggle for non-premium users navigates to /premium. One minor UI bug: invalid Feather icon name 'infinity' in premium.tsx (console warning and icon renders as '?').

ui_bugs.issue: Uses Feather icon name 'infinity' which is not a valid Feather glyph. Console warning: '"infinity" is not a valid icon name for family "feather"'. Icon renders as '?' in the premium feature list. Reference: /app/frontend/app/premium.tsx:21

action_items: Replace Feather icon 'infinity' in /app/frontend/app/premium.tsx FEATURES array (line ~21) with a valid Feather glyph (e.g. 'repeat', 'refresh-cw', 'maximize-2') or switch to a family that supports infinity (MaterialCommunityIcons name='infinity').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/goals correctly enforces FREE_ACTIVE_GOAL_LIMIT=5 and bypasses on is_premium=True. Edge-case 'status=concluida' is allowed even when at the limit, which is reasonable.
POST /api/achievements/check inserts dict(entry) (copy) so motor cannot inject _id into the response payload (fix from iteration 1 verified working).
POST /api/clear-data correctly clears achievements collection in addition to goals and profile.
GET /api/reports/monthly always returns evolution with exactly 30 entries and by_priority initialized with all three buckets — safe for empty data.
Profile model defaults is_premium=False and notifications_enabled=False; ProfileUpdate exposes both fields for PUT.
seed_data_creation: Tests use POST /api/clear-data fixtures and clean up. Final state at end of run: cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend external URL: https://rocket-forward.preview.emergentagent.com. Iteration 2 features (achievements, monthly report, premium demo, free-limit gating) all validated end-to-end. Criar-meta save uses data-testid='modal-save' (not 'save-goal'). Available testIDs on /criar-meta: modal-close, input-title, input-description, input-date, input-time, date-YYYY-MM-DD, priority-{baixa|media|alta}, category-{...}, status-{pendente|em_andamento|concluida}, modal-cancel, modal-save. Achievement modal testIDs: achievement-modal, achievement-modal-close. Free-tier limit triggers HTTP 402 detail.code='FREE_LIMIT_REACHED' and frontend redirects to /premium on toast.
rca_of_issue: premium.tsx FEATURES uses 'infinity' as Feather icon name — Feather icon set does not include an 'infinity' glyph (verified by runtime warning '"infinity" is not a valid icon name for family "feather"'). Resolution: change to a valid Feather glyph or switch family. Does not impact functionality, only the visual icon on the Premium 'Metas ilimitadas' row.
